items.User: A mobile-first anime streaming-style web app in the spirit of the Anime Cloud phone app: a dark navy theme with a blue gradient accent, a home screen with a featured banner carousel, rows for Trending, New Episodes, Popular and genres, a search screen with filters, an anime detail page (poster, synopsis, genres, rating, episode list) and a My List / watch history screen saved in the browser, with a bottom tab bar. Use a built-in sample catalog of real anime titles (metadata only) and play official trailers through YouTube embeds instead of full episodes; never link to or stream unlicensed episodes. Use an original name and logo, not Anime Cloud's.
